data.long_meaning: Mijanur is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Maha Janu', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is associated with immense power, wisdom, and divinity. Mijanur is believed to be a powerful protector and a giver of blessings. The name Mijanur carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mijanur usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
